newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Reunert sees 15 pct fall in H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Reunert sees 15 pct fall in H1 profits.

text.p: Electronics group Reunert Ltd said on Wednesday it would not match first half earnings of the previous year and a reduction of about 15 percent in profits could be expected.
"Although turnover is up on the previous year, operating margins are under pressure and have declined," Reunert chairman Clive Parker said.
"As a result, the company will not match the earnings of the first half of the previous year and a reduction of about 15 percent in profits can be expected," Parker said.
He said that while conditions were expected to improve in the second six month period, it was unlikely that the shortfall would be fully recouped by year-end.
Reunert shares were last trading at 13.00 rand each -- a fall of 200 cents, but were off a year low of 12.50 touched earlier in heavy volume trade.
